title: A critical-point criterion for D-stability in every dimension
summary: Johnson's contact criterion for D-stability is expressed as an explicit principal-minor critical-point system. For every real square matrix and every choice of positive barrier weights, D-stability is equivalent to Hurwitz stability and the absence of positive solutions of the associated Fritz-John equations. The proof applies a proper exhaustion of the positive orthant to Johnson's contact variety, so that every nonempty contact set contains a critical point.
